script_text:
Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now.

Saturn, your air-forged ruling planet, is squaring your 10th House of career while Pluto in your sign sextiles your 7th House of intimacy, forcing a power shift.

Your air element craves freedom, yet Saturn demands mature structure before you release control.

In love, a tense Saturn-Uranus aspect means your partner may test independence tonight; do not abandon the bond before you communicate your needs clearly. If single, this sextile makes you magnetize someone fiercely unconventional.

Financially, that Saturn square in your 2nd House asks you to audit your resources before bold moves, but the Pluto sextile in the 8th House could unlock a valuable joint opportunity. The 10th House tension may redirect your public path toward reinvention.

Avoid impulsive promises, and watch for an unexpected blessing through trusted allies.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
